view.scene_description: A large warehouse interior with high ceilings, concrete floors, and industrial shelving. Blue metal racks hold goods on multiple levels. Pallets with boxes and crates are scattered throughout. A mezzanine level with railings is visible. Lighting fixtures hang from the ceiling. A person is seated at a desk in the background. Equipment like carts and forklifts are present.

objects.label: blue metal shelving units
objects.observation: Tall blue metal racks with multiple shelves, filled with various items including yellow bins and boxes. Located along the left wall and extending into the background. Some shelves are empty. Mounted to the wall and floor. Partially occluded by other objects.

objects.label: stacked red plastic crates
objects.observation: Several stacks of bright red plastic crates arranged on wooden pallets in the center-right area. Crates are uniformly stacked. Placed on pallets on the floor. No visible supports other than pallets. Not occluding any major objects.

objects.label: wooden pallet with wrapped goods
objects.observation: A wooden pallet carrying a large, shrink-wrapped package, located near the center-left. The package is rectangular and transparently wrapped. Resting directly on the concrete floor. Partially occluded by a cardboard box.

objects.label: person sitting at desk
objects.observation: A person seated at a black office desk with a chair, positioned in the mid-background. Their face is blurred. They appear to be working or handling items. Desk has papers and containers. Chair wheels are visible on the floor.

objects.label: mezzanine walkway with railing
objects.observation: An elevated walkway with blue metal railings and mesh panels, spanning across the upper right portion of the image. Appears to connect different sections of the warehouse. Supported by vertical posts anchored to the floor. Partially occludes background elements.

objects.label: yellow plastic crates
objects.observation: Yellow plastic crates stacked on a pallet and placed on a table-like structure in the right foreground. Crates are rectangular and uniform. Positioned on a yellow-painted surface. Not occluded by other objects.

objects.label: wooden hand truck
objects.observation: A wooden hand truck with wheels, located in the lower-left corner. It has a flat wooden platform and handlebars. Empty and stationary. Wheels are on the concrete floor. Partially occluded by shelving unit.

objects.label: blue metal cart with wheels
objects.observation: A blue metal cart with wheels, loaded with boxes and yellow crates, located in the center-right. Cart has a flatbed and handles. Wheels are on the concrete floor. Not occluded by other objects.

objects.label: concrete floor
objects.observation: Smooth, light gray concrete floor covering the entire ground area. Reflects some overhead lighting. No visible seams or cracks. Serves as base for all objects.

objects.label: overhead lighting fixtures
objects.observation: White fluorescent lighting fixtures suspended from the ceiling by wires. Multiple fixtures are visible along the top edge of the frame. Emitting bright light. Hanging from ceiling beams.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s3-36397", "image_size": [1920, 1080], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
